technical_note: This pack preserves the generated art at native resolution and provides deterministic regional files. Because generative image output does not guarantee mathematically exact transparent item boundaries, Codex must not invent alpha or collision. Assets that still contain sheet background should be treated as source art and flagged for clean-export replacement rather than degraded.
